title: Small stela of Hornakht, YPM ANT 261382

object.name: Small stela of Hornakht (Yale Peabody Museum YPM ANT 261382)
object.content: Name of Hornakht and his immediate family

source.attribution: Yale Peabody Museum, Division of Anthropology. CC0

notes: YPM catalog number YPM ANT 261382 (accession YPM.10017, received via donation, 1996). Script per the YPM record: "contains six lines of cursive hieroglyphic text (a hybrid of hieroglyphic and hieratic forms)"; findspot Abydos, Egypt. Photo by J. Domian, 2006 (IIIF canvas 3 of the manifest), full frame, no crop. Control item; note the museum itself calls the hand a hybrid of hieroglyphic and hieratic forms, so this is a hard boundary case. License: the IIIF manifest (https://manifests.collections.yale.edu/ypm/nat/254915) gives rights https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ and the statement 'Open Access; see museum policies at http://hdl.handle.net/10079/8931zqj'.
